name: Orgnil Soulscar
summary: At Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar watches for threats within Durotar. He gathers intelligence and coordinates defenses against dangers to the young orc nation, especially the Burning Blade cult in the canyons.

sections.title: Watcher of Razor Hill
sections.body: At Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar tracks hidden threats across Durotar. While grunt patrols watch for Alliance forces and centaur raiders, he looks for danger among the orcs themselves. Scouts bring him reports from across the region, and he searches them for signs of corrupt rituals and secret gatherings.

sections.title: Hunting the Shadow Council's Remnants
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar hunts the Burning Blade cult, whose warlocks hide in caves such as Skull Rock. Fel magic devastated the orcish people in past generations, and he will not let demon worship gain ground near Orgrimmar. He sends trusted recruits against cultists to gather ritual talismans. He also sends them to consult local hermits and shamans such as Margoz about the dark magic at work.

faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar is an orc official at Razor Hill who investigates threats and coordinates Durotar's defense. He directs warriors and scouts against dangers to the newly settled orc lands.

faq.q: What threat is Orgnil most worried about?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar is focused on rooting out the Burning Blade cult. Its presence in Durotar's hidden caverns and its corrupting fel magic threaten the fresh start Thrall envisions for the Horde.

faq.q: Why does Orgnil send travelers to Margoz?
faq.answer: Margoz is a knowledgeable hermit living north of Razor Hill who understands the Burning Blade's signs and rituals. Orgnil sends scouts to him to read the cult's movements and investigate the spreading magical corruption.

faq.q: Where can Orgnil Soulscar be found?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar is stationed outdoors in Razor Hill, near Durotar's central crossroads.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade in Durotar?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is a cult bound to demonic masters and the Shadow Council. Its members hide in ravines such as Skull Rock and Dustwind Cave, trying to poison Durotar's wildlife and draw young orcs back into demonic service.

faq.q: Does Orgnil work directly for Thrall?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar works within the regional defense force based in Razor Hill, carrying out the Warchief's order to protect Durotar from sedition and demonic influence.

angles.text: As a young orc, you can see Orgnil as a guard against the demonic taint that once enslaved the clans. His work reminds new recruits to stay vigilant and keep their homeland pure.
As a warlock, you must tread carefully around Orgnil, whose focus is rooting out uncontrolled demonic corruption within Durotar.
As a member of the Horde, you can count on Orgnil to guard its heartland from cultists within while the Horde builds its new nation.
